title: feat(contacts): page through the contact list with offset
description: Integrations need to read every contact, not only the first page. Adds an `offset` query parameter to `GET /v1/contacts`, documented in the reference, with its test.
rationale: `offset` reaches `skip()` unchecked: a negative value makes MongoDB reject the query, so the public endpoint answers 500 instead of 400, and `offset=abc` silently reads the first page. A public parameter is validated (a non-negative integer) and refused with 400 otherwise.
